review_scope: All 66 units read in Chinese–English alignment including both tables, title/deck, the two narrowed claims about Gandhi, the three kinds of standing, and all verification limits. Five local corrections; no rewriting of the complete English.

changes.before: The position of disagreement is not whether to act, but that the two criteria have different principal trigger variables. Gandhi's path is triggered by the character of the action itself and the standing of its practitioners — is the cause just, can these people hold the discipline, has violence broken out, is the aim conversion or coercion. SAE's Theorem One is triggered by the channels of relation and the other party's conduct — are the mild forms still open, what did the other party give in answer, has the carrier of cultivation been lost.
changes.after: The position of disagreement is not whether to act, but that the two criteria have different principal trigger variables. Gandhi's path is triggered by the character of the action itself and the standing of its practitioners — is the cause just, can these people hold the discipline, has violence broken out, is the aim conversion or coercion. SAE's Theorem One is triggered by the channels of relation and the other party's conduct — are the mild forms still open, what did the other party give in answer to each approach, has the carrier of cultivation been lost.
changes.reason: Restore the repeated, case-by-case evidence in 对每一次接近.

changes.before: And this volume makes no ranking of strictness. To write that satyagraha's discipline is stricter than that of violent resistance is an unavailable comparison — the two disciplines require different things (one requires not striking back and continuing to bear; the other requires obedience and coordination), and there is no common scale on which to rank them. This volume does not need such a judgement.
changes.after: And this volume makes no ranking of strictness. To write that satyagraha's discipline is stricter than that of armed resistance is an unavailable comparison — the two disciplines require different things (one requires not striking back and continuing to bear; the other requires obedience and coordination), and there is no common scale on which to rank them. This volume does not need such a judgement.
changes.reason: Restore 武装抵抗, which is narrower than all violent resistance.

changes.before: So he is not absolutely non-violent without regard to conditions. He has a fairly strict set of conditions; they simply are not all in the same place.
changes.after: So he is not absolutely non-violent without regard to conditions. He has a fairly strict set of conditions; they simply do not sit in the same place as SAE’s.
changes.reason: The comparison concerns the location of Gandhi’s conditions versus SAE’s, not a dispersion among Gandhi’s own four conditions.

changes.before: Trap two: taking Gandhi does not respond to situation and carries no burden of judgement for a property of his path. This is writing a different path as a correction of it. Gandhi likewise faces difficult judgements: whether a cause is just is a judgement of qualification; whether participants can hold is an organisational judgement; whether violence has broken out far enough to require suspension is a judgement of fact. He too must make these under pressure, and can get them wrong. So the difference between the two paths is not that one requires judgement and the other does not; it is that the objects of judgement differ.
changes.after: Trap two: taking Gandhi does not respond to situation and carries no burden of judgement for a property of his path. This is writing a different path as a correction of it. Gandhi likewise faces difficult judgements: whether a cause is just is a judgement of qualification; whether participants can hold is an organisational judgement; whether violence has become serious enough to require suspension is a judgement of fact. He too must make these under pressure, and can get them wrong. So the difference between the two paths is not that one requires judgement and the other does not; it is that the objects of judgement differ.
changes.reason: Restore the severity threshold, not an unclear spatial extent of outbreak.

changes.before: SAE's criterion outputs a may, and it must therefore bear that may being misused and abused. The mild forms have been exhausted can be said by anyone who wants a war. And the difference of Gandhi's path on this point must be stated exactly. To say Gandhi's path will not be abused in this way is too strong — any set of claims can be abused; a non-violent movement can equally be used to suppress internal dissent, to require of others a cost they should not have to bear, or to justify inaction.
changes.after: SAE's criterion issues a permission, and it must therefore bear that permission being misused and abused. The mild forms have been exhausted can be said by anyone who wants a war. And the difference of Gandhi's path on this point must be stated exactly. To say Gandhi's path will not be abused in this way is too strong — any set of claims can be abused; a non-violent movement can equally be used to suppress internal dissent, to require of others a cost they should not have to bear, or to justify inaction.
changes.reason: Make the normative meaning of 可以 explicit, not a possibility claim.

metadata_changes.before: Gandhi and SAE are structurally joined at one point: both refuse to reduce the other party to a disposable thing. The disagreement is not whether to act but where each criterion's trigger variables sit.
metadata_changes.after: Gandhi and SAE are structurally joined at one point: both refuse to reduce the other party to a disposable thing. The disagreement is not whether to act but where each criterion's trigger variables sit. One points toward the practitioners on one’s own side, the other toward the channels between the two parties.
metadata_changes.reason: Restore the deck’s explicit contrast between own practitioners and relational channels.
